rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００１Hi! I was passing by,￥so I thought I'd drop in￥and see if you were home.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００２Say, something good happened to￥you lately, didn't it? You seem￥to be doing so well!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００３Hey! Tell your big sister￥what's going on!!
Nothing, really.
If so, I'm not telling.
Nothing, really.
If so, I'm not telling.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００４I see. Then all your hard work￥must be paying off!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００５Aww, what's that about?＝＠０８４＿００６That's mean. I only asked￥because I honestly thought it￥was amazing.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００７But after doing that well this￥time, the hard part comes next.＝＠０８４＿００８Frankly, I think keeping the￥same rank next time will be￥really tough...
I'll manage somehow.
That's what worries me.
I'll manage somehow.
That's what worries me.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿００９True. I'd say it's impossible￥for anyone else... but you might￥just pull it off!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１０I know how you feel.￥But... this is when you have￥to dig in!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１１If you can't hold your place,￥then... you either climb higher,￥or you start to slip!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１２As a fellow candidate, I can't￥say this too openly, but I'm￥rooting for you!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１３Let's both give it our best￥next time too, okay?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１４Sorry to bother you while you're￥resting. See you in the￥training room!
